# Daily Dashboard V0.5.7

Calendar event previews now fade their background dimming and blur in and out over 160 ms. The backdrop stays mounted through dismissal so the fade-out completes smoothly, including when closing with Escape. Reduced-motion settings disable the animation.

## Verification

Production frontend build and frontend checks pass. Browser verification covers all 456 widget/size/display combinations and calendar hover containment, keyboard dismissal and pinned details at 16 size/display combinations. Rendered-frame checks verify intermediate opacity in both fade directions, the final hidden state, pointer transparency and reduced-motion behaviour.

The fade uses the shared frontend on Windows and macOS. The application identity and saved settings location remain unchanged for upgrades from earlier releases.
